Hi Elena — thanks for the patience while we dug in. Summary of findings and next steps below.

1) Root cause (provenance):
- We extracted request-level logs for Novum's org-id for 2024-06-02 00:00–2024-06-03 12:00 UTC. The spike corresponds to a cluster of ~7,100 short streaming responses coming from three request IDs that entered a retry loop due to transient gRPC timeouts at our EU-1 edge (region eu-west-1). The retry logic in our edge proxy retried a subset of client requests with a misconfigured idempotency flag which resulted in duplicate processing for a 45-minute window (02:08–02:53 UTC).
- The model variant used across the requests was evergreen:text-8k (v1.2). The duplicates were charged per token as usual; the duplicates appear as additional tokens in the billing export. We have identified the affected request IDs and redacted traces; attached is an excerpt (novum_kv_trace_excerpt-20240605.json) with request IDs and timestamps (redacted payloads).

2) VAT handling:
- Our finance team reviewed the invoice. Because the billing entity on file for your account is Redwood US LLC and the invoice was issued from that entity without a reverse-charge claim on file, VAT was applied. Since Novum provided a valid EU VAT number and is entitled to reverse-charge, we will reissue the June invoice with VAT reversed. Please confirm the VAT number one last time for our records.

3) Remediation & credit:
- We will issue a provisional credit for the duplicate tokens identified (full token credit for the duplicates flagged) and reissue the corrected invoice with VAT reversed. The provisional credit amount will appear as a contra-charge on your June statement; we aim to process this within 7 business days.
- We are also deploying a hotfix to prevent the idempotency/retry misconfiguration from occurring again and will run a retrospective audit for similar anomalies the prior 30 days.

4) Evidence & attachments:
- Attached: novum_kv_trace_excerpt-20240605.json (redacted traces), billing_export-may-june.csv, and a short walk-through doc link.

If you want a shared session to review the traces, Rafael and I are available Thursday morning (your timezone) — tell us a time and we'll set it up.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll make this right.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
